mapper.select:
SELECT FROM tb_customer_info WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId}
AND ( customer_code ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR customer_name ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR COALESCE(cust_name_abbr, '') ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' )
AND COALESCE(president_name, '') ILIKE '%' || #{presidentName} || '%'
AND COALESCE(business_no, '') ILIKE '%' || #{businessNo} || '%'
AND COALESCE(jurid_no, '') ILIKE '%' || #{juridNo} || '%'
AND COALESCE(business_status_1, '') ILIKE '%' || #{businessStatus1} || '%'
AND COALESCE(business_item_1, '') ILIKE '%' || #{businessItem1} || '%'
AND use_at = #{useAt}
ORDER BY customer_code ASC, customer_id ASC

INSERT INTO tb_customer_info ( tenant_id, customer_code, customer_name, cust_name_abbr, president_name, business_no, jurid_no, business_status_1, business_item_1, post_code, address, telephone_no, facsimile_no, cust_memo, use_at, created_by, updated_by ) VALUES ( #{tenantId}, #{customerCode}, #{customerName}, #{custNameAbbr}, #{presidentName}, #{businessNo}, #{juridNo}, #{businessStatus1}, #{businessItem1}, #{postCode}, #{address}, #{telephoneNo}, #{facsimileNo}, #{custMemo}, #{useAt}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy} ) RETURNING customer_id
